يختفوا (form VIII)
# يَخْتَفُوا (yaḵtafū) /jax.ta.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
# يُخْتَفَوْا (yuḵtafaw) /jux.ta.faw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَفَى (iḵtafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
